coachBetBody: Tap a chip, then DEAL. This table starts at {min} per hand.
coachNpcBody: Practice bots play first. Your turn begins when HIT and STAND become available.
coachPlayBody: Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. HIT adds a card; STAND ends your turn. Over 21 loses.
coachSettleBody: Your result shows your bet, hand return and any sweep pot separately. Continue when ready.
coachDealerBody: The dealer draws below 17 and stands on all 17s. Look at the visible dealer card before choosing your move.
coachPushBody: An equal total is a push: your bet returns. Going over 21 loses, even if the dealer also busts.
coachPotBody: Losing bets from other seats form the sweep pot. Beat the dealer with the best remaining total (ties count) to take it.
coachMovesBody: DOUBLE adds an equal bet and one card. SPLIT separates a pair with another bet. SURRENDER returns half your opening bet.
coachDoneBody: You have finished the three coached hands. Reopen the rules or replay the tutorial from Settings anytime.
coachInsuranceBody: Insurance costs half your bet and pays 2:1 only if the dealer has blackjack. You can decline.
guideCardsBody: Number cards keep their value. J, Q and K count 10. An Ace counts 1 or 11, whichever keeps the hand at 21 or below.
guidePayoutsBody: A win pays 1:1, natural blackjack pays 3:2, a push returns your bet, and surrender returns half. A dealer blackjack beats any non-natural 21.
guideChipsBody: Table limits appear in the lobby. Rebuy and daily bonuses have cooldowns; check the chip options when your balance is low.
